arguments.command:
# Save current state
CURRENT_STATE=$(jj log -r @ --no-graph --template '{commit_id}')
echo "Current state: $CURRENT_STATE"

# Rebase B (tqqnlztx) onto base (xxlusksu)
jj rebase -r tqqnlztx -d xxlusksu

# Show the new state
jj log -n 10

# Restore to original state
jj checkout $CURRENT_STATE
jj log -n 10
